_comment: An eval set is written from your own corpus and belongs outside this repo, at
~/Library/Application Support/second-brain/eval/seed.json. This file only shows the shape.
`expect` and `forbid` are document titles. `forbid` is the half that catches the failure
nobody looks for: one sprawling document that ranks into the top three of every unrelated
question, which makes recall go up while the answers get worse.
`refusal` questions must be genuinely absent from the corpus -- they measure whether the
system says so instead of inventing something confident about your own work.

retrieval.question: how long is the deep work block?
what goes in a decision journal entry?

refusal.question: what did we agree about enterprise pricing?
who is on call this weekend?
